title: The scattering matrix for the p-form Laplacian on asymptotically conic manifolds
summary: The Hodge decomposition at infinity gives rise to distinct tangential scattering channels for differential forms on asymptotically conic manifolds. We construct co-closed generalized eigenforms for the Hodge Laplacian on $p$-forms in dimension $n\geq 3$ and analyze the resulting Bessel and Hankel systems. From these we determine the scattering matrix modulo smoothing operators, identifying it as a Fourier integral operator associated to the time $π$ geodesic flow and whose principal symbol encodes fibre-wise parallel transport with respect to the Levi-Civita connection on differential forms.…
